trip_command: cd /app && rm -f cap1.json; ( sleep 0.5; for i in $(seq 1 5); do curl -s -m 1 http://185.199.108.153/ping$i -o /dev/null & done; ping -c 2 -W 1 127.0.0.1 >/dev/null 2>&1 & sleep 3 ) & ./network_analyzer --capture 3 --output cap1.json; echo "capture exit=$?"; sleep 0.5; echo "=== cap1.json ==="; cat cap1.json; echo "=== valid json? ==="; python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('cap1.json'));print('OK total=',d['summary']['total_packets'],'tcp=',d['summary']['tcp_packets'],'udp=',d['summary']['udp_packets'],'n_packets=',len(d['packets']))"
